newsitem.title: CANADA: Seagram operating units' Q2 EBITDA up.
newsitem.headline: Seagram operating units' Q2 EBITDA up.

text.p: Seagram Co Ltd, reporting improved fiscal second quarter results, said Wednesday the attributed revenues of its Universal music group increased 13 percent in the period, primarily due to a significant improvement in music.
Seagram said most of Universal's 13 percent increase in earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) came from music and theme parks.

The company said its Spirits and Wine Group earnings improved despite extremely difficult market conditions in Europe and Asia Pacific. It said these conditions have continued into the current quarter.
Spirits and Wine Group EBITDA increased nine percent in the second quarter, ended December 31, reflecting North America's particularly strong performance, the company said.
The Beverage Group attributed revenues increased five percent, benefiting from the continued success of Tropicana Pure Premium, it said.
